embeddableConfig.description: Every PostgreSQL instance with its latest Cloud SQL state and saturation readings, sorted by memory utilization. Instances that stopped during the range are listed with their latest state; instances stopped for the whole range report no PostgreSQL metrics and are not listed. RUNNING (not serving) means up = 0. Failed logins % is the share of connection attempts rejected in the selected range: wrong credentials, a bad deploy or brute-force attempts. Values are taken per minute first and then the latest minute is shown, so an instance never double-counts. Click an instance to open its detail dashboard or the Google Cloud console; the Google Cloud console link is also in each row's … menu.
